name: mirage
text: Likely cause found, and it's bigger than matching. The switches for the engine's Pinnacle-fed live lane (the live taker and live bids) were both OFF in the settings. That lane is the only one that prices tennis. The lane behind the Live tab's count uses ESPN scoreboards for US team sports, so tennis could never show there. I just switched both on, in paper mode only, with real orders still off, and the engine reads it immediately. In a few minutes I'll check what the lane says and whether the tennis names match Novig's events (Novig writes them like 'Player Round of 128'). If they don't match, I'll fix the matching. To go real, one switch (gates.sharpApiLiveReal) plus liveBidReal, which I'd only flip after reading paper results.
